title: relevos: a relay race
summary: Four processes pass the baton with signals, in order.
hints: The first runner must know the second one's pid, and so on: create the children in REVERSE order (runner 4 first), so each child already inherits the pid of the next runner from the parent.

Install the `SIGUSR1` handler (it just sets a flag) before the first fork. A runner waits with `while (!go) pause();`. IMPORTANT: `fflush(stdout)` before every `kill`, or the next runner's output can be written before yours.
Before the start the parent sleeps one second: a signal sent before a runner reaches `pause()` is not queued for it and the runner could wait forever.
